node.statement: Proposition 2.6 (Permutation factorization): For registers A_1,...,A_n with Hilbert space C^d and B_1,...,B_n with Hilbert space C^r, and for all pi in S_n: P_{AB}(pi) = P_A(pi) tensor P_B(pi). That is, permuting joint registers (A_k, B_k) is the same as independently permuting the A-registers and B-registers. Proof: direct verification on computational basis states |a_1, b_1> tensor ... tensor |a_n, b_n>.
